---
title: "Overall survival — primary imputation"
subtitle: "50 independent one-imputation MICE branches"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

This is the primary OS imputation stage. Every branch is independent and is
checkpointed separately, so an interrupted run resumes without silently
reducing the required `m = 50`.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "paths-artifacts.R"))
source(here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-validation.R"))
source(here::here("R", "imputation.R"))
source(here::here("R", "survival-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"))

runtime <- module_runtime()
config <- runtime$config
input_path <- project_path("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "prepared.parquet")
indices <- module_exact_indices(config)
if (length(indices) != 50L) stop("Primary OS requires exactly 50 imputation branches.")
branch_dir <- ensure_directory(project_path("artifacts", "primary", "overall-survival", "imputations"))
code_paths <- module_code_paths(
  here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"), here::here("R", "imputation.R"),
  here::here("R", "survival-helpers.R"),
  here::here("R", "checkpoints.R"), here::here("analysis", "module-runtime.R"),
  knitr::current_input()
)
```

```{r}
#| label: impute-os
#| include: false
prepared <- module_read_parquet(input_path)
module_require_columns(
  prepared,
  c("id", "tx", "survival_time_days", "event_death", "ecog_binary",
    "ecog_fstcnt", "stage_binary", "lung", "mgps", "age", "gender", "albumin",
    "c_reactive_protein"),
  "prepared OS data"
)
init <- mice::mice(prepared, m = 0, maxit = 0, printFlag = FALSE)
methods <- init$method
predictors <- init$predictorMatrix
fixed_columns <- intersect(
  c("id", "tx", "survival_time_days", "event_death"), names(prepared)
)
methods[fixed_columns] <- ""
predictors[, fixed_columns] <- 0
predictors[fixed_columns, ] <- 0
methods["mgps"] <- ""
predictors[, "mgps"] <- 0
predictors["mgps", ] <- 0
# ECOG binary is a deterministic analysis derivative of ecog_fstcnt; keep the
# source variable in the stochastic imputation model and recompute this flag
# after every completed branch.
methods["ecog_binary"] <- ""
predictors[, "ecog_binary"] <- 0
predictors["ecog_binary", ] <- 0
validate_mice_spec(prepared, methods, predictors)

for (index in indices) {
  output_path <- file.path(branch_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", index))
  module_branch(
    runtime = runtime,
    stage_id = sprintf("primary-os-imputation-%02d", index),
    input_paths = input_path,
    output_paths = output_path,
    code_paths = code_paths,
    metadata = list(endpoint = "overall_survival", imputation = index, m = 50L, maxit = 50L),
    worker = function() {
      fitted <- mice::mice(
        data = prepared,
        method = methods,
        predictorMatrix = predictors,
        m = 1L,
        maxit = as.integer(config$imputation$main$maxit),
        donors = as.integer(config$imputation$main$donors),
        seed = analysis_seed(config, "imputation", index),
        printFlag = FALSE
      )
      completed <- mice::complete(fitted, action = 1L)
      completed$ecog_binary <- derive_ecog_binary(completed$ecog_fstcnt)
      completed$mgps <- derive_mgps(completed$albumin, completed$c_reactive_protein)
      assert_ecog_binary_consistent(completed)
      assert_mgps_consistent(completed)
      module_save_parquet(completed, output_path)
    }
  )
}
created <- file.exists(file.path(branch_dir, sprintf("imputation-%02d.parquet", indices)))
if (length(created) != 50L || !all(created)) {
  stop("OS imputation stage did not produce all 50 required branches.")
}
```
